description: This file defines a repository class for managing hashed links in a database, including methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving links with detailed related data, using Prisma ORM.

classes.name: HashedLinkRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling hashed link database operations, including CRUD and complex queries with related data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of HashedLinkRepository using the Prisma client.

methods.name: deleteLinks
methods.description: Deletes multiple links associated with a specific event type.

methods.name: createLink
methods.description: Creates a new hashed link with specified data.

methods.name: updateLink
methods.description: Updates an existing link's expiration and usage count.

methods.name: findLinksByEventTypeId
methods.description: Retrieves links associated with a specific event type ID.

methods.name: findLinkWithEventTypeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves a link with associated event type details (teamId, userId).

methods.name: findLinkWithDetails
methods.description: Retrieves a link with detailed related data as defined in hashedLinkSelect.

methods.name: findLinksWithEventTypeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves multiple links with their event type details.

methods.name: findLinkWithValidationData
methods.description: Retrieves a link with validation data including user, team, host, profile, owner time zones.

methods.name: incrementUsage
methods.description: Increments the usage count of a link if below max usage count.
